name: Test AX Capsule Stack G
summary: AX line: CM-8 'Ares' capsule on the ST-L service trunk (Dragon-style: the trunk mates to the capsule's heat-shield carrier land; conformal solar cells + radiators, 4 Medium slots).

parts.note: AX-cmd-12 (4 Medium slots in slots.positions, jettisoned before entry)

staging.title: Trunk sep
staging.note: Jettison the trunk before entry; the capsule enters shield-first.

manual:
# Test AX Capsule Stack G
Capsule node_bottom (heat-shield carrier land) -> trunk node_top. The separate HS-1 heat shield (AX-cmd-15) and the SM-L service module (AX-cmd-13) are left out: their bounding boxes are not centred between their stack nodes (shield dome / OMS nozzle hang below node_bottom), and assemble.js centres the overlap box between the nodes, so it would flag the joint as overlapping.
